bugs.error_message: Contract suite expected order would fail a correct store that keeps microsecond timestamps (sub-microsecond pair tied in the store, ordered by tie-breaker, but the oracle compared full ticks)
bugs.root_cause: ContractOrder.Sort compared CreatedAt at tick precision, i.e. the in-memory store's semantics, not the store under test.
bugs.fix: IPageSourceFixture.TimestampPrecision (default 1 microsecond); the oracle compares timestamps at it. In-memory fixture declares one tick. MyStoreContractTests (README skeleton) runs the suite over a microsecond store.

bugs.error_message: Testing with VSTest target is no longer supported by Microsoft.Testing.Platform on .NET 10 SDK
bugs.root_cause: xunit.v3 runs on Microsoft.Testing.Platform; .NET 10 dotnet test defaults to VSTest.
bugs.fix: global.json test.runner = Microsoft.Testing.Platform; drop Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk and xunit.runner.visualstudio from the test project.

bugs.error_message: Wrong reference: PagingException should be BadHttpRequestException

bugs.root_cause: Minimal APIs parse enum query values with case-sensitive Enum.TryParse against member names, so lower-case wire values never bind to PascalCase members.
bugs.fix: PagingKind became a readonly record struct with IParsable (case-insensitive TryParse) plus a TypeConverter for MVC; a schema transformer in AddAntPageResponses restores the string enum in OpenAPI.

bugs.root_cause: MVC uses the parameter name as model prefix whenever a query key equals it; ?paging= matched parameter 'paging', so properties were looked up as paging.paging, paging.page.
bugs.fix: [Bind(Prefix = "")] on PagingRequest forces the empty prefix regardless of parameter name.

bugs.error_message: CS9137 interceptors feature not enabled in Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi.Generated
bugs.root_cause: Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi's source generator flows through a ProjectReference but its build targets (which set InterceptorsNamespaces) do not.
bugs.fix: Add InterceptorsNamespaces $(InterceptorsNamespaces);Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi.Generated in in-repo consumers (Tests, Example); package nuspec keeps exclude=Build,Analyzers.

bugs.error_message: GetOrCreateSchemaAsync schemas inlined per operation, not shared components
bugs.root_cause: OpenApiOperationTransformerContext.GetOrCreateSchemaAsync returns inline schemas and does not register components.
bugs.fix: Read schema.Metadata["x-schema-id"], document.AddComponent(id, schema) once, return new OpenApiSchemaReference(id, document).
